title: Midnight Nutella Dip (Community Enhanced)
instructions: Combine chocolate-hazelnut spread, milk, honey, and vanilla extract in a small microwave-safe container.
Heat in microwave oven until desired consistency is reached.
Stir the dip with a toothpick until somewhat smooth; let cool for 2 minutes before eating.
Taste the sauce and adjust the consistency by adding more half-and-half if needed.

source_review.text: Ok, so honestly, I didn't follow recipe but used almost the ingredients listed. I just added nutella, and honey and half and half and vanilla extract. I just tasted as I went. I feel like I added more half and half than the ratio listed to get a smooth and thinner sauce. I used it for beignet dipping and it was AMAZING. Lots of love from the hubby and all my friends that tried it. Heated in microwave and reheated well. YUM! A keeper.
